components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-emphasis action with the implemented water-wave fill.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; color: #fff; background: radial-gradient(circle at 14% 115%, #0b6578 0 21%, transparent 48%), radial-gradient(circle at 92% -22%, #0a5f8f 0 17%, transparent 43%), linear-gradient(118deg, #063b78 0%, #075a91 52%, #086d7c 100%); font: 650 13px 'Inter Variable', Inter, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 5px 13px rgba(8,127,215,.25); transition: transform 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 7px 17px rgba(8,127,215,.32); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(8,127,215,.32); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Connection Input
components.description: Compact setup field with the same focus signal as the task rail.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #d3d5da; border-radius: 7px; color: #202124; background: #fff; font: 13px 'Inter Variable', Inter, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #087fd7; outline: 3px solid rgba(8,127,215,.32); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Pin Toggle
components.description: Always-on-top state control with a clear active fill.
components.css: .ds-pin { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(118deg, #063b78 0%, #075a91 52%, #086d7c 100%); font: 650 11px 'Inter Variable', Inter, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(8,127,215,.28); } .ds-pin:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-pin:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(8,127,215,.32); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Task Row
components.description: Flat active-work item with priority, estimate, workflow state, and a right-edge completion action.
components.html: Prepare launch briefMKTG-71 · M · In Progress
components.css: .ds-task { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8px minmax(0,1fr) 32px; gap: 11px; align-items: start; padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e3e7; color: #202124; background: #fff; font: 13px 'Inter Variable', Inter, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-task:hover { background: #f3f3f5; } .ds-task > i { width: 8px; height: 8px; margin-top: 5px; border-radius: 3px; background: #d28a26; } .ds-task strong, .ds-task small { display: block; } .ds-task small { margin-top: 6px; color: #6b6f76; font-size: 10px; } .ds-task button { width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; color: #202124; background: transparent; } .ds-task button:hover { background: #e7f5ff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(8,127,215,.22); } .ds-task button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(8,127,215,.32); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Compact Task Row
components.description: Dense row with one-line name, estimate, state mark, and the same right-edge completion control.
components.css: .ds-task-compact { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8px minmax(0,1fr) auto auto 32px; gap: 9px; align-items: center; padding: 7px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e3e7; color: #202124; background: #fff; font: 12px 'Inter Variable', Inter, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-task-compact > i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 3px; background: #d28a26; } .ds-task-compact strong { overflow: hidden; font-weight: 550; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-task-compact small { padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 4px; color: #6b6f76; background: #f3f3f5; } .ds-task-compact b { width: 13px; height: 13px; border: 1.5px solid #d28a26; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-task-compact button { width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; } .ds-task-compact button:hover { background: #e7f5ff; }

components.name: Tray Icon
components.description: Water-blue resident mark for Windows and Linux; macOS uses the matching monochrome template asset.
components.css: .ds-tray { display: grid; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 4px; place-items: center; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(145deg, #075a91, #086d7c); font: 10px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: A narrow strip of moving water attached to the edge of a monitor: calm, dense, and immediately legible. Expression lives in precise alignment and a deep-to-clear water signal rather than decorative chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet neutral canvases with one layered water-blue signal.
Information-first rows instead of a card grid.
Compact controls that remain unmistakably interactive.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Water blue marks selection, action, or live state; it is not background decoration.

rules.name: The Density Rule
rules.body: Card density changes what a row says, never where the rail lives. Chrome and density are separate controls.

rules.name: The Recoverable Rule
rules.body: Never hide the window anywhere the user cannot get it back from. If the tray surface is missing, ordinary window behaviour returns.

dos: Do keep the active task list visible without navigation.
Do use native platform affordances for window behavior.
Do make connection and empty states actionable.
Do make task-state changes visible and reversible.
donts: Don't turn each task into a floating dashboard card.
Don't expose API credentials in renderer code or persisted plain text.
Don't add task mutations without an explicit target state and Undo path.
Don't hide the window anywhere the user cannot get it back from.
